svg.title: The Moon passing through the Earth's shadow
svg.desc: The Earth's shadow at the Moon's distance, seen face on: a dark inner disc, the umbra, inside a paler ring, the penumbra. The Moon sits in the middle of the umbra, tinted copper. When played, the Moon moves from left to right through the penumbra and the umbra and out again, its copper tint deepening inside the umbra and fading outside it.
svg.text: Still frame: totality. The Moon is in the umbra and lit only by sunlight bent through the Earth's atmosphere.
